title: Symfony UX 3.8 released: The Optimization Update
content:
<html><head></head><body>Symfony UX 3.8 is out, two and a half weeks after 3.7. It adds UX Upload, a
cva() function to UX CSS, and moves the Shadcn kit of the UX Toolkit onto
the native APIs of the browser.
It is also the optimization update: 60 of its 91 pull requests make a package…</body></html>
